execution_hints: Create one deterministic Python script in the current workspace root and run it once to produce and check all artifacts; do not place helper files under outputs.
Do not install dependencies, probe optional packages, use network access, or write to an operating-system temporary directory.
Use NumPy directly for the repeated dense linear solves when it is already importable; otherwise use a deterministic standard-library solver.
Write text artifacts explicitly as UTF-8; keep generated source ASCII-safe on Windows and emit non-ASCII SVG text with Unicode escapes when necessary.
method_contract: Use the fixture exponential semivariogram: gamma(0)=0 and gamma(h)=nugget + partial_sill * (1 - exp(-h/range_m)) for h greater than zero; do not substitute a covariance model or multiply distance by an undocumented factor.
Solve the ordinary-kriging semivariance system with a Lagrange multiplier, predict from the solved weights, and report standard deviation as sqrt(max(sum(weight_i * gamma_i) + multiplier, 0)).
Predict at cell centers x=origin_x+(column+0.5)*cell_size_m and y=origin_y+(row+0.5)*cell_size_m; rows advance south-to-north and surface values are rounded to six decimals.
Summarize each census zone from the already six-decimal surface cells whose centers satisfy the half-open bbox; do not average unrounded intermediate predictions.

Set selection_status to selected only when heat and elderly-rate thresholds pass and uncertainty is within the ceiling; otherwise use uncertainty_excluded when heat and elderly-rate pass but uncertainty fails, and not_selected for all other zones.

Build empirical bins from each unique unordered point pair exactly once using lower < lag <= upper, then run the declared four spatial holdout folds in order NE, NW, SE, SW without random-only validation.

requirements: Use variable ordinary_kriging_temperature_mean, units degrees Celsius, and row_order south-to-north.
Build the grid from fixture metadata and round every value to six decimals.
Use variable ordinary_kriging_standard_deviation and units degrees Celsius.
Use the identical grid identity and six-decimal rounding as the temperature surface.
Use this exact column order and fixture census-zone order.
Compute elderly_rate as elderly_population divided by total_population.
Calculate temperature and uncertainty means from the serialized six-decimal surfaces, then serialize all three calculated fields to six decimals.

Include accessible title and description elements.
Include text Mean temperature (°C), Excluded: uncertainty, Projection: EPSG:32636, and manual fixed temperature classes.
The semantic validator checks accessibility, census coverage, classification and projection evidence; it does not require byte-identical SVG markup.
